examined: Remaining lease margin at callback and after response
Expiry and one-second remaining vs normal 60-second autosave cycle
Atomic exact-token renewal preserves stored data and operation markers
Foreign and same-job acquisition races re-evaluate current record
Response delay/response loss after renewed lease and newer foreign save
Slow responses exhaust existing attempt budget without writable bindings
Existing save-operation acknowledgement does not restamp foreign lease
Prior no-restamp regression now scoped to sufficient remaining lifetime

limitations: Simulated cloned persistence with controlled wall clock, callback retries and fault injection; not native Roblox DataStore or network evidence
120-second admission margin is not a guarantee against arbitrary later process pauses, scheduling delays, clock issues or outages
In-flight requests and lock waits cannot be cancelled by recovery deadline; acquisition retains separate attempt budget
Memory-only recovery/admission metadata cannot survive process loss
No new native Studio/device/microphone/multiplayer validation; mixed-version drain and isolated real persistence tests remain release gates
No live DataStore access, publication or audio configuration
